meta.title: Knockout: vendors can only accept or reject a target price
gaps: Dedicated Knockout strategy configuration and publishing fields (base price, tick size, and knockout time difference) are not represented by a catalog step.
warnings: resolved: “Proving that accept and reject are the only actions available on the vendor screen, with no other possible controls, can” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Create the source RFQ required before converting to a Knockout auction.
Create an RFQ-only project, since Knockout auctions are reached through RFQ conversion.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Commit the event schedule before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor required for the vendor-side check.
Publish the RFQ so it can be converted.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the converted-auction create screen, the supported route to Knockout auctions.

args.goal: configure the converted auction as a Knockout auction with its required target-price settings, publish it, and stop on the published event ready for the invited vendor

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for selecting Knockout or entering its required settings, so perform that buyer-side configuration on screen.
Inspect the invited vendor's supplier-portal view.
Open the Knockout auction's vendor bidding screen.
Assert that the vendor screen identifies a target price.
Assert that the vendor can accept the shown target price.
Assert that the vendor can reject the shown target price.
Confirm the inspected vendor screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid rendering.
